notes: The smelting itself (fuel values, canSmelt, the cook timer) is tileticks.c's furnace tick, gated by te-furnace-s1 (8 iron ore on coal, output taken with 6 XP, then 4 porkchops on planks; 2,573 rows). The S31 progress bars are gated by containers2-s42's cp.fur (cobblestone smelted with coal, 450 rows with the window open). The native play client's furnace screen draws the client container's S31-written furnace_progress (lane/hudscreens).
